title: Largest Subarray with 0 Sum
stepTitle: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
category: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
problemStatement: Length of the longest subarray whose elements sum to zero.
intuition: If the same prefix sum appears at indices i and j, the elements between them cancel to zero. Longest means you keep the earliest index for each prefix value.

approaches.title: Optimal: first-occurrence prefix map
approaches.idea: Seed {0: -1} so a zero-sum prefix is handled uniformly.
approaches.dryRun:
a=[9,-3,3,-1,6,-5]
pre: 9,6,9,8,14,9
pre=9 first at 0, seen again at 2 -> len 2, and at 5 -> len 5
approaches.whyWorks: Equal prefixes bracket a zero-sum block; earliest occurrence maximises the span.

interviewInsight: The 0/1-equal-count variant is the common disguise; mention the 0 -> -1 remap.
